summary.text: Cobi Clark is the Libertarian candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 47-Position 1, facing Democratic incumbent Debra Entenman in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Clark described a career in real estate development and said he is focused on economic growth and housing supply.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Cobi Clark said he was raised in Covington and started his first business just out of high school, which led to a career in real estate development.

He wrote that he lives in Auburn with his wife and two sons, was named a top 40 under 40 business professional by South Sound Business, and holds an interdisciplinary degree in economics, policy analysis, politics and philosophy.
He also said he worked as policy staff for Senator Jeff Wilson and as a business advocate for the Tacoma-Pierce Chamber of Commerce.
Clark wrote that he wants politics focused on protecting individual life, liberty and property and on economic growth rather than dividing the economic pie.
He called for structural reform of zoning, building and energy codes and the building codes council to restore housing supply and reduce housing costs.
